headword: {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}

definitions.gloss: thirteenth death anniversary; memorial service held in the twelfth year after a death
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist memorial service marking the thirteenth observance of someone's death, held twelve calendar years after the death (counted inclusively).

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: We reached my mother's thirteenth-year memorial.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧だ。
examples.english: This is the year of my grandfather's thirteenth-year memorial.

examples.japanese: {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}った→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧。
examples.english: We held the thirteenth-year memorial quietly with just family.

notes:
Like other ⟦{回忌|かいき}→回忌：12127_kaiki⟧, counted inclusively: the death year is year 1, so {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき} falls twelve calendar years after the death. By this stage attendance is usually limited to immediate family.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧: thirteenth-year memorial service
- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to hold the thirteenth-year service
- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: for the thirteenth-year memorial to come around

MEMORIAL SERVICE SEQUENCE:

- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}: 12 years after death
